verdict.rationale: Pipedream ships an official hosted remote MCP server at remote.mcp.pipedream.net, and any MCP client can point at it. It supports SSE and streamable HTTP automatically and has documented headers, managed auth, per-app servers, and integrations with the Vercel AI SDK and Claude's Messages API; a probe confirms the official MCP docs exist. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that an agent connects and executes tools successfully (all evidence is vendor docs).
